title: Where's Google going next? | Larry Page
summary: A TED2014 interview in which Charlie Rose talks with Google CEO Larry Page about the company's long-term vision, including balloons for internet access and the DeepMind acquisition. Page also discusses data sharing and privacy.
why: Cited for specific Larry Page statements, such as on sharing medical data for research and personalized search being a hard problem.
